args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1). Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

Summary of what I did:
- **Diagnosed**: `get_service_status` showed checkout-api on v2.3.1, unhealthy with an 18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
- **Identified target**: `list_deployments` showed v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was unhealthy).
- **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions — confirmed `rolled_out`/`VERIFIED`.
- **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 `INC-0001` for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0.
